ContextSnapshotInput.description:
Fixed evidence-time context dimensions.

``freshness_basis`` is intentionally an opaque, non-empty source-provided
string because the specification requires the basis to be preserved but does
not define a controlled vocabulary or timestamp-only representation.
ContextSnapshotInput.title: ContextSnapshotInput

DeterministicAIFallback.description: Typed non-model result assembled only from the EvidenceBundle.
DeterministicAIFallback.title: DeterministicAIFallback

FallbackEvidenceFact.description:
Canonical fact copied from a sealed EvidenceBundle.

Similarity metadata is intentionally omitted here. The deterministic
fallback communicates canonical evidence facts, not model confidence or
semantic-equivalence probabilities.
FallbackEvidenceFact.title: FallbackEvidenceFact

IncidentEvidenceRelationshipType.description:
Controlled MVP vocabulary for why evidence is attached to an incident.

RELATED is intentionally broad because the specification does not yet define
finer evidence roles. RECURRENCE and VERIFICATION are kept explicit because
they have lifecycle meaning in the MVP requirements.
IncidentEvidenceRelationshipType.title: IncidentEvidenceRelationshipType
